Regulation: B.C. Reg. 120/2026
Made under: Provincial Sales Tax Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 10, 2026

B.C. Reg. 120/2026, deposited July 10, 2026, under thePROVINCIAL SALES TAX ACT[section 240]. Order in Council 303/2026, approved and ordered July 10, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that Schedule 2 to the Designated Accommodation Area Tax Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2013, is amended in column 4 of item 21 by striking out "August 1, 2026" and substituting "August 1, 2031". — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; J. WICKENS,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. Index Page|Previous Regulation|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: Vancouver accommodation tax extended to 2031 — no action needed now
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has extended the designated accommodation area tax for Vancouver by five years. This tax, which applies to short-term accommodation like hotel rooms, was set to expire on August 1, 2026, but will now continue until August 1, 2031. The change was made official on July 10, 2026, and simply keeps the existing tax in place for a longer period.

key_dates.label: Vancouver accommodation tax extension takes effect (replaces 2026 expiry)
Vancouver accommodation tax now set to expire
